desc: 大尺寸厚实无纺布湿巾，居家清洁与外出应急多场景代入
name: 厚实加大无香成人湿巾款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整组堆叠传达囤货量感与翻盖包装结构。
把外出尴尬瞬间具象化，一眼让买家代入并引出抽取动作。
用夸张幽默的卫浴桥段锁定使用情境，并在下方留出一排空胶囊承接卖点。
三人对称构图制造社交代入感，用干净与狼狈两种状态讲同一件事。
把巾体尺寸与覆盖面积讲清楚，消除会不会太小的规格疑虑。
用纤维与压边微距证明厚实度与用料质感。
保留三栏并置对照的说服结构，用空白样牌承接各自主张。
以包装背板结构收口，把说明区与标识区留成空白证据位降低风险感。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, plus a rounded cyan #35C1EE or matte black #101014 inner panel inside a black frame, hairline capsule and column motifs
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight icons in cyan #35C1EE only, outline style, used as blank framed slots
style.lightingSystem: cool bright high-key studio light, large front-left key with bounce fill, soft contact shadows, skimming side sweep only on texture close-ups
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold high-contrast hygiene-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF field, electric cyan #35C1EE inner panel, matte black #101014 frame and mist grey #EDF1F4 secondary surface; cool bright high-key studio lighting with a large front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif layout kept as empty plates; rounded capsule and column motifs with a single hairline outline; thin-line outline icons in one accent colour only; stable locked product scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered text or invented badges.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or rendered lettering
no filled-in badges, seals or spec numbers
style.presentationRules: locked product scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on angle across the set, packs always grounded by a contact shadow, sheet texture shown flat and un-stretched
style.surfaceSystem: matte board fields: seamless white #FFFFFF, mist grey #EDF1F4, matte black #101014; porcelain and clear-water surfaces in scene panels
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif grid kept as empty headline plates and blank label capsules, no rendered glyphs
